Package hadur2.core.melee

Class TeamDanger

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.TeamDanger
public final class TeamDanger extends Object
T6, learned team danger (MMOVE-9, MMOVE-10): what the team has learnt of each enemy's gun.

Each enemy bullet that hits a member becomes a TeamDanger.Sample: the member's situation when the bullet left the gun, as the shooter saw it, and the guess factor the bullet took (0 head-on, +1 the furthest the member could have got the way it was going). The member keeps the sample and sends it to its teammates over the link, so each member's log of an enemy's gun holds the hits on all five. A shot that member detects is then dodged where the nearest samples say the enemy aims, in place of MMOVE-3's head-on and linear guesses, once the log holds MIN_SAMPLES.

Two switches, both off in the shipped build: NEAREST (MMOVE-9, a shot is aimed at the member nearest the shooter, so the others leave it alone) and LEARNED (MMOVE-10, the learned aims). Either acts only while Hadur has a living teammate: off a team, or as the last member alive, nothing here is reached.
